trailhead.label: Miribel-Lanchâtre town hall, the board’s start

cautions: A short stretch of scree before the Gresse torrent can be slippery after heavy rain.
A ford across the Pierre du Mai stream.
Farm gates to close behind you; the D 8 is crossed and briefly followed at the end.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Gresse valley loop from Miribel-Lanchâtr: Anello della valle della Gresse da Miribel-Lanchâtre
textIt.Miribel-Lanchâtre town hall, the board’s: Municipio di Miribel-Lanchâtre, la partenza della scheda ufficiale
textIt.A short stretch of scree before the Gres: Un breve tratto di ghiaione prima del torrente Gresse può essere scivoloso dopo forti piogge.
Un guado sul torrente Pierre du Mai.
textIt.Farm gates to close behind you; the D 8: Cancelli dei pascoli da richiudere dietro di te; alla fine si attraversa la D 8 e la si segue per un breve tratto.
